members.name: sender
members.doc: Who the turn is from. A user message shows its content in a filled bubble.

members.name: author
members.doc: Content shown above the message, such as its author's name.

members.name: actions
members.doc: Compact buttons for the message. Pressed makes one a toggle.

members.name: sources
members.doc: What the reply relied on, listed behind a count button. Only http, https, and relative links stay links.

members.name: sourcesExpanded
members.doc: Whether the source list is open, when the caller controls it.

members.name: defaultSourcesExpanded
members.doc: Whether the source list starts open, when Message controls it.

members.name: onSourcesExpandedChange
members.doc: Reports the source list opening or closing.

members.name: followUps
members.doc: Suggested next messages. They render only with onFollowUp.

members.name: onFollowUp
members.doc: Reports the chosen follow-up. Message sends nothing.

members.name: streaming
members.doc: Adds the streaming status text while the caller updates the content.

members.name: streamingLabel
members.doc: The status text announced while streaming.
